section2.paragraph: For years, silence, misinformation and lack of knowledge have reinforced **customs, walls and barriers that hide the violence and discrimination many girls face as they grow up.**

section3.title: Such a natural topic, ignored for so long: ==why talk about it now?==
section3.text: The dignity and rights of girls and adolescents are like seawater: they never expire. At **Las Fuertes**, we set sail on a mission with no turning back, guided by a unique educational map that breaks down those walls and barriers.

welcome.subtitle: from Isla Fuerte, Colombia
welcome.body: A space where **comprehensive menstrual education** becomes a tool for transformation. Here, we walk alongside girls and adolescents as they learn to understand their cycles and **live them with freedom and confidence.**

emi.title: Comprehensive menstrual education as a map for change
emi.paragraph1: From that attentive listening and the desire to turn the tide, **CME** was born: our **Comprehensive Menstrual Education program.**
emi.paragraph2: A living proposal, woven from experience on Isla Fuerte and other territories across Colombia, which taught us that menstrual education alone is not enough: **we need a broad, holistic vision** that allows every girl to inhabit her body with freedom and pride.

donations.title: Comprehensive menstrual education needs a committed crew to steer change
donations.paragraph1: **Turn your money into collective action.** More valuable than any investment because it takes us to new destinations while deepening our impact.
donations.paragraph2: Every contribution creates a wave... and your sustained support helps it travel farther, shaping currents of change and new opportunities.

educationMap.title: How we turn our educational map into a route toward conscious, holistic development

talleres.name: Workshops (CME)
talleres.body: They are always at the center. We create safe spaces where, through workshops and our own method, menstrual education becomes a bridge toward new opportunities.
talleres.imageAlt: Three girls point at a poster about internal reproductive anatomy during a workshop.

clubes.name:
Reading and
Play Clubs
clubes.body: We create more spaces for self-discovery where girls can grow up feeling safe and free. Through playful and educational activities, we help girls and teenagers strengthen their confidence.
clubes.imageAlt: A group of girls works around outdoor tables at a reading club.

ruta.name:
My Route,
My Destination
ruta.body: Las Fuertes Juniors continue discovering their talents, skills and areas for growth, strengthening their self-esteem and the way they see themselves. With that self-knowledge as a foundation, we support them in making conscious decisions about their short-, medium- and long-term future.
ruta.imageAlt: A group of girls and teenagers holds up their new backpacks and smiles.

chiquifuertes.name: Chiquifuertes
chiquifuertes.body: Girls discovering their first territory: their own bodies. Through play and drawing, we nurture their imagination, teamwork and self-knowledge, sowing the skills to grow up strong, creative and free.
chiquifuertes.imageAlt: Two girls draw and color while sitting on a mat.

voces.name:
Sovereign Voices:
Youth Leadership
voces.body: Our work does not stop at puberty: going further is essential to nurture the value of community work as a tool for individual and collective transformation. At Las Fuertes, one voice becomes many as we weave a network of dozens.
voces.imageAlt: Two teenagers and a Las Fuertes facilitator sit together for a portrait.

quienesSomos.title: Who we are
quienesSomos.text: We are a reef of women, volunteers and allies growing from Bogotá toward Colombia's forgotten territories. We build spaces where knowledge of the body is not whispered but shared, where comprehensive menstrual education is not a luxury but a right. And where every adolescent finds her own voice to navigate her life with clarity, confidence and freedom.

terminos.metaDescripcion: How we protect the photos of our girls, what the site stores in your browser and how donations to Fundación Las Fuertes work.
terminos.intro: By browsing this site you accept these terms. We wrote them plainly, with no fine print: if something is unclear, write to us.

responsable.p1: This site belongs to **Fundación Las Fuertes**, an organization from Isla Fuerte, Bolívar, Colombia, that supports girls and adolescents through Comprehensive Menstrual Education (CME).
responsable.p2: Tax ID (NIT): 901.809.186-3. Legal representative: Karoll Adriana Lopez Lozano, Colombian citizenship ID (cédula) 52.717.530.
responsable.p3: You can write to us at fundacionlasfuertes@gmail.com, on Instagram (@las.fuertes) or on LinkedIn (Fundación Las Fuertes).

menores.titulo: Child protection and use of the photos
menores.p1: This site contains photos of **girls who are minors (under 18)** according to Colombian law. We use them with the permission of their families and only to tell the story of the foundation's work.
menores.p2: **We do not authorize** copying, downloading, sharing, modifying or publishing these photos anywhere else, under any circumstances. Nor do we authorize their use with **artificial intelligence**: not to train models, not to feed them, and not to generate images from them.
menores.p3: That is why, before you enter, the site shows a child protection notice that you have to accept. Accepting it means you commit to respecting these conditions.
menores.p4: We ask machines too: our robots.txt file closes the image folders to known artificial intelligence crawlers and to Google Images, and every image on the site is served with the X-Robots-Tag header "noimageai, noai". The foundation's text remains public.

cookies.titulo: Cookies and data in your browser
cookies.p1: **lf_aviso**: remembers that you already accepted the child protection notice, so we don't show it on every visit. It lasts 365 days, applies to the whole site and holds no personal data: only the version of the notice you accepted. If we change the notice, we'll ask you again. If you delete it or browse in private mode, the notice comes back.
cookies.p2: **Google Analytics and Mixpanel**: we measure, in aggregate and anonymously, how the site is used (for example, how many people open Join us or click to donate). Google Analytics uses its own cookies for this, and Mixpanel stores an anonymous identifier in your browser, so we know two visits come from the same device without knowing who you are. We don't use them to identify you and we don't ask for personal data.
cookies.p3: With Mixpanel we also record browsing sessions, to see where the site is hard to follow. In those recordings **every image is blocked**: the girls' photos are never shown. Whatever you type in text fields is hidden. Beyond this, the site stores nothing else in your browser: no accounts and no forms.

donaciones.p1: You can support the foundation from **Join us**, the panel opened by the "Join us", "I want to contribute" and "Donate here" buttons.
donaciones.p2: **One-time donation (Colombia)**: the payment is processed by **Bold**, in Colombian pesos, with a minimum of COP 5,000. This site never sees or stores your card or account details: it only prepares the donation reference and amount, and Bold makes the charge. When you finish, Bold emails you the receipt and brings you back to a thank-you page with the reference and the payment status.
donaciones.p3: **Monthly donation**: made through a **Mercado Pago** subscription. Mercado Pago sends you a receipt for each charge, and you can manage or cancel the subscription from your account at any time.
donaciones.p4: **From the United States**: you can donate through our partner Caring for Colombia, a 501(c)(3) organization, on the Give Lively platform. Those donations follow that platform's terms.
donaciones.p5: **Time and goods**: volunteering and in-kind donations are coordinated over WhatsApp; there you only share what you decide to write to us.
donaciones.p6: **Refunds and tax matters** (such as donation certificates): handled by writing directly to the foundation at fundacionlasfuertes@gmail.com.
